name: North East Rubber Public Company Limited
summary: North East Rubber Public Company Limited manufactures and sells rubber products in Thailand. It offers rubber smoked sheets, skim block rubbers, mixtures rubber, ribbed smoked, and standard Thai rubbers primarily for the automotive industry. The company also exports its products to Singapore, China, Japan, Cambodia, and India. North East Rubber Public Company Limited was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Prakhon Chai, Thailand.
